sermon.title: Things Which Must Shortly Come to Pass 10/8/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that Revelation is the revelation of Jesus Christ, then explains “shortly” and “hereafter,” the sealed scroll only the slain Lamb can open, the new song of every nation, the fifth-seal martyrs, the sixth-seal day of wrath with the church still present, the multitude out of great tribulation, and Daniel’s sealed book that only the Lamb will open.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Transcript begins at 0:02. Points to check: nations “discovered until the late 1700s”; “Mount Everest is in South America ... Australia is in the North Sea” (spoken as a picture of moved mountains/islands). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Catholic church ran Europe, corrupt, killed and tortured dissenters; seven-year tribulation “not in there at all they have to manufacture it”; no rapture; author “a millionaire selling books” on Daniel; communism and Muslims rule by force, “both enemies of Christianity and the gospel”.
